no-restricted-globals.name: setTimeout
no-restricted-globals.message: Use ctx.setTimeout — cleared when the widget is removed, errors stay inside the widget.

no-restricted-globals.name: setInterval
no-restricted-globals.message: Use ctx.setInterval — cleared when the widget is removed, errors stay inside the widget.

no-restricted-globals.name: cancelAnimationFrame
no-restricted-globals.message: ctx.raf callbacks are cancelled with the widget.

no-restricted-globals.name: MutationObserver
no-restricted-globals.message: Widgets watch their own data, not the page.

no-restricted-globals.name: localStorage
no-restricted-globals.message: Use ctx.local(name, fallback) (per device) or ctx.state(name, fallback) (synced).

no-restricted-globals.name: fetch
no-restricted-globals.message: Use ctx.fetchJSON / ctx.fetchText (proxy fallback, data meter), or ctx.api for your backend integration.

no-restricted-properties.message: Dashboard internals are not part of the widget API.

patterns.message: An integration imports only ../integration-kit.js (and its own files): secrets, env and storage come through ctx.
